entities.summary: Andrew Kofi Egyapa Mercer is a Ghanaian lawyer and politician. He is member of the New Patriotic Party. He is the immediate past Member of Parliament for the Sekondi Constituency in the Western Region of Ghana. He succeeded Papa Owusu-Ankomah, who had been MP for 20 years.
